body:
## What to build

Part of #329. Preserve the customer’s quotation as the place where its experience and appraisal are conveyed, rather than summarizing its answer immediately before repeating it. Final source-account candidate 5ecadb76, supplementary case-question-en_GB-r1, introduces the last quotation with “Vale’s endorsement was specific to new jobs, with more time allowed before extending its use”. The immediately following quotation supplies precisely those two points. The preceding authentic-question framing is supported and useful; the answer summary is the defect.

The case-study base already says that a bridge should prepare a quotation rather than pre-say it. Root and two independent readers judge this a concrete G2 progression defect under that unchanged criterion. All claims remain source-supported, so F1 passes and #352’s genuinely supplied question stays a positive control. Source checking must not be expanded into editorial review to conceal this separate failure.

Complete evidence: docs/evaluation/editorial-329/followup/runs/account-candidate/case-question-en_GB-r1/write/, including supplied-input.md, artifact.md, response.txt and native reports. The paired source-blind Redline is assessed independently; any successful downstream repair does not retroactively turn the Write draft into a pass. A similar pre-echo in the preceding original-US case was correctly removed by Redline, distinct from that run’s separate quotation-preservation failure.

Diagnose whether any actual composition/review instruction conflict exists before proposing a change. An already-clear rule should not be lengthened with this fixture’s sentence or a quotation quota.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Preserve the full failed draft and unchanged G2 judgment while retaining its separate F1 pass.
- [ ] A fresh unchanged-source case presents useful context before the quotation without immediately repeating its complete appraisal.
- [ ] Preserve authentic question framing, customer perspective, qualified endorsement and every source limitation without imposing a canonical bridge.
- [ ] Assess the separate source-blind Redline result and record any successful repair or remaining failure independently.
- [ ] Run the four CONTRIBUTING checks for any integrated change; record an existing-contract execution limitation honestly if no justified repair is established.

---
Written against 5ecadb76

comments.body:
Write-felet kvarstår och ärendet hålls öppet. Det parade källblinda Redline-provet på samma 5ecadb76 rättar däremot bryggan till ”Asked about choosing the system again and what to change, Vale said:”. Den genuint lämnade frågan, hela kundcitatet och texten i övrigt bevaras. Ingen utsaga går förlorad, och fullständig mekanisk filöverföring passerar.

Redline-reparationen gör inte det ursprungliga Write-utkastets G2-bedömning godkänd i efterhand. Den befintliga kompositionsregeln är tydlig, och inget nytt belagt instruktionsfel har motiverat en generell extra regel eller en fixturespecifik citatbrygga.

Evidens: `docs/evaluation/editorial-329/followup/runs/account-candidate/case-question-en_GB-r1`, `reviews/account-new.md` och separata Write/Redline-records för 344-account-new.

Lokalt integrerat i `main` vid `12373d807e7f872e88ea4bb795af9b065c075dc5`; verifierad produktrevision `5ecadb76`. Alla fyra CONTRIBUTING-kontroller passerar, inklusive 1 873 tester. Oberoende teknisk/protokoll- och redaktionell helhetsgranskning är genomförda. Inget är pushat, releasat eller globalt installerat. Samlat slutresultat: `docs/evaluation/editorial-329/followup/completion-report.md`.

title: Write: prepare customer quotations without pre-saying their appraisal
